verdict.headline: You can connect your own dev account instantly, but moving to production requires planning around 2026 usage tiers, role permissions, and strict bans on AI/ML model training.
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: 15 to 30 minutes. Driven by developer account signup, app creation, and configuring your OAuth redirect URI and scopes.
verdict.timeToProduction: Same day for uncertified apps up to 5 tenant limits; weeks to months if pursuing Xero App Store certification or enterprise tiering.
verdict.handsOnEffort: Moderate: OAuth app setup is quick, but you must implement token encryption, handle granular scopes, and comply with strict AI training prohibitions.
verdict.cost: Free to start building; commercial pricing models feature usage-based tiers (Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise) based on active connections and data egress volumes.
verdict.biggestRisk: Using Xero API data to train AI or machine learning models is explicitly prohibited, which can instantly violate developer terms.

ownAppDecision.summary: You must register your own OAuth app with Xero and provide your Client ID and Client Secret to Composio.
reasons: Xero requires third-party developers to register their own OAuth applications via the Xero Developer Portal.
Connection capacity and pricing tiers (such as the 5 uncertified app tenant limit) are tied directly to your registered app.
Composio uses your custom Client ID and Client Secret to handle the multi-tenant OAuth exchange on your behalf.

phases.name: Prepare & Account Setup
phases.goal: Have a free developer portal account and a clear understanding of Xero's security and AI-use restrictions.

steps.title: Create a Xero Developer Account
steps.detail: Sign up for a free developer account on the Xero Developer Platform to gain access to the developer portal.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can open the portal link and guide you through the initial registration fields.

steps.title: Review AI Training Restrictions
steps.detail: Ensure your AI agent design complies with Xero policy: data obtained via Xero's APIs must never be used to train AI or machine learning models.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can summarize policy constraints and review your prompt/data flow design against terms.

phases.name: Build & OAuth Configuration
phases.goal: Register your OAuth app, implement token management, and successfully connect your first Xero organization.

steps.title: Create the OAuth 2.0 App
steps.detail: In the Xero Developer Portal, create a new app, select 'Auth Code' as the grant type, and securely copy your Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can generate the boilerplate configuration code using your Client ID and secret variables.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.detail: Add your redirect URIs in the portal. Ensure they use HTTPS (or localhost for development) and match exact strings with no trailing slash discrepancies.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can validate your callback routes and verify string-exact matches between your code and configuration.

steps.title: Implement Granular Scopes and Offline Access
steps.detail: Include the offline_access scope along with required granular scopes (e.g., accounting.contacts, accounting.transactions) in your authorization request.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can generate the complete authorization URL string with proper space-separated scope encoding.

steps.title: Secure Token Storage
steps.detail: Write code to encrypt refresh tokens in persistent memory using symmetric encryption (AES-128 or higher) and enforce TLS 1.2+ in transit.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can write database models and encryption helper functions using standard cryptographic libraries.

phases.name: Go Live & Scale
phases.goal: Deploy your integration, monitor rate limits and egress data, and optionally pursue certification.

steps.title: Track Connections and Egress Volumes
steps.detail: Monitor your active connections and daily API data downloads using the Egress Usage Report in the Xero developer portal dashboard.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can poll dashboard metrics or help set up alerts for threshold limits.

steps.title: Apply for Certification (Optional)
steps.detail: If exceeding the 5-tenant uncertified app limit or wishing to list on the Xero App Store, submit your app through the certification checkpoints.
steps.agentHelp: An AI agent can help draft your app store description, privacy policy, and compliance documentation.

requirements.detail: Required to access the portal, create apps, and retrieve credentials.
Xero requires secure callback endpoints; custom mobile URL schemes must use HTTPS wrappers or localhost.
Mandatory security standard to encrypt refresh tokens stored in persistent memory.
Required to qualify for official App Partner certification and bypass the 5-tenant uncertified app limit.

permissions.name: offline_access
permissions.purpose: Enables the app to receive refresh tokens so the AI agent can perform background synchronization without re-prompting the user.
permissions.notes: Required alongside standard scopes if persistent access is needed.

permissions.name: accounting.contacts
permissions.purpose: Allows the AI agent to read and write customer and supplier contact records.
permissions.notes: Part of the granular scopes framework introduced to replace legacy broad permissions.

permissions.name: accounting.transactions
permissions.purpose: Allows the AI agent to view, create, or update invoices, bills, and credit notes.
permissions.notes: Requires appropriate Xero user roles; bank mutations also require BankAccountAdmin permissions.

nuances.title: Role-Based Endpoint Enforcement (403 Errors)
nuances.detail: Xero aligns API authorization with Xero Central roles. If the user authorizing the connection lacks permissions (such as BankAccountAdmin for bank details), API calls will return a 403 error.

nuances.title: Granular Scopes Transition
nuances.detail: New OAuth apps must use Xero's granular scopes. Existing apps have a migration window until September 2027.

nuances.title: Strict AI Training Ban
nuances.detail: Developer terms strictly prohibit using any data obtained via Xero APIs to train artificial intelligence or machine learning models.

blockers.symptom: An organization cannot connect your app because the tenant has reached the maximum cap of 5 uncertified apps.
blockers.howToProceed: You must either disconnect another uncertified app from that tenant or complete the Xero App Partner certification process.

blockers.symptom: API requests fail with a 403 authorization error code when attempting specific mutations like updating bank account details.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the authenticating user has been assigned the required Xero Central role (e.g., BankAccountAdmin) within that tenant organization.
